item.tib: mi men tshogs kyis zhus lan
item.coloph: de ltar bdag gi rmi lam 'khrul snang 'di/ dkar chag yi ger btab pa bzod par gsol/ bka' srung rnams kyis 'phrag dogs mi mdzad zhu/ 'di bris dge ba'i mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul gyis/ nam mkha'i (mkhas) khyab tshad bon dbyings bkra shis shog gangs chen bod du bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan bon/ nub pa med par yongs su 'dzug par shog u ya/ gsang ngo / bka' drin can gyi mtha' bzhi rang grol la/ las 'phro can gyi bya bral bdag gis zhus so//
